turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Singh? This is Inspector Vikram Rathore calling from the Mumbai Cyber Cell.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Singh. What is the matter, officer?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, we have intercepted a courier containing illegal narcotics and several fake passports addressed to you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? I have not ordered any such thing. There must be a mistake.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your Aadhaar is linked to this shipment, and this is now a digital arrest case. You must stay on this call and not tell anyone, or you will be detained immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am very worried. Please, how can I prove that I am innocent?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To clear your name and avoid the police coming to your house, you need to undergo a security verification process.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Verification? How do I do that?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You must transfer twenty five thousand rupees to the government's safe verification account. Once the funds are cleared, we will release your documents.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I do not have that much ready. Can I talk to my son first?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you hang up or tell anyone, it will be seen as tampering with evidence and you will be arrested tonight.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Please, just give me some time to think.
